_note: The functional flow requirements trace to (nine blocks, from the team's flow). Edit here. Descriptions are drafts written from the sub-steps; the sub-steps (steps) are copied from the team's flow.

functions.name: Acquire Environment & Field Data
functions.description: Sensors, tags and ranger devices measure conditions, attach observation metadata, format a standardized data message, set its priority and queue it for transmission.

functions.name: Transmit Data to Ground
functions.description: The terminal selects a satellite path, links up and sends the message; the satellite receives and validates it, directs it to the right ground terminal, forwards it to the ground system and acknowledges reception.
steps: Direct message towards correct ground terminal

functions.name: Process Data
functions.description: The ground system receives and validates the message, reconciles it with existing records, stores it in the central database, updates current models and distributes the information to monitors.
steps: Reconcile incoming observations with existing records

functions.name: Evaluate Conditions
functions.description: Relevant data is retrieved, measurements are compared with predefined thresholds and correlated across sources, hazard severity and location are assessed, and the need for an alert is decided.
steps: Correlate observations of multiple data sources

functions.name: Generate Alerts
functions.description: A proposed alert is generated, validated against its source data, customized for the geographic location of the hazard and completed as a full alert message.
steps: Validate alert information and source data
Customize alert for geographic location of hazard

functions.name: Broadcast Alerts
functions.description: Target recipients and the delivery pathway are chosen; the alert goes from the ground system to the satellite network, is relayed across it and delivered to community receivers and responders, and delivery status is reported.
steps: Transmit alert from ground system to satellite network
Deliver alert to community receivers and responders

functions.name: Receive & Present Alerts
functions.description: The receiver or terminal receives and validates the alert, converts text to spoken audio if required, activates the community notification interface, presents the alert, records reception status and transmits an acknowledgement.
steps: Receive alert on receiver or terminal
Convert alert text into spoken audio if required

functions.name: Monitor System
functions.description: Delivery acknowledgments are received and alert delivery status updated, missing acknowledgments are identified, satellite and terminal health is inspected and operators are notified of degradation.
steps: Notify operators of degradation if necessary

functions.name: Coordinate Response
functions.description: Messages from responders are received and the sender authenticated and prioritized; messages go through the satellite network and are delivered to the outpost, return commands are received and return messages relayed, field reports update the models and communication queues are maintained.
steps: Update models with relevant field reports
